timestamp_unit: integer days since fictional world start, UTC midnight

semantics.immutable: Ledger corrections append new signed entries; engagement reclassification appends a version with later observed_at
semantics.as_of: Only acquired leads and records with occurrence/economic and observed timestamps <= cutoff; engagement uses latest revision visible then; missing observation time is unavailable, not zero
semantics.engagement: Distinct final-qualified human lead clickers at an occurrence date divided by original acquired leads; never a death definition
semantics.contactability: Operationally eligible leads, including inactive/dormant leads; acceptance means recipient-server acceptance only
semantics.payback_state: by_180, later_than_180, never_under_policy; endpoint refers to finite policy, not unrestricted lifetime
semantics.point_forecast: draw_id=0, forecast_type=point, probability_profitable=null; deterministic point paths are not posterior draws or calibrated probabilities
semantics.truth_access: GeneratorTruth separate from World; model functions receive Snapshot and Policy, never GeneratorTruth
semantics.accounting: Negative acquisition and sending ledger entries, signed revenue/reversal/revision entries; margin uses economic date and as-of report availability
